Equality implies exactly four nonzero endpoint-supported columns, equal quarter powers, phase product relation and the specified orthogonality. Four-by-four Walsh construction attains; single-lag and Fourier benchmarks agree with exact arithmetic. The fourth-moment formula follows from proper i.i.d. moments and the traceless shift. Remaining limitations: no independent audit and no claims for other lag sets.
